welcome_message: 👋 Welcome to {app_name}! You'll be matched with a random stranger for a private, anonymous conversation. • 🔍 /search — find a stranger • ⏭ /next — skip to next partner • 🛑 /stop — end current chat • 💳 /pay — Premium & VIP plans • 🌐 /language — change language Your identity is never revealed.
help_message: Commands: /start — show welcome screen /search — join the queue and find a match /next — disconnect and find the next stranger /stop — leave the current chat /pay — view Premium / VIP plans /vip — learn about VIP benefits /language — change your language Premium (⭐100 Stars): gender filter VIP (⭐250 Stars): priority matching
gender_prompt: First, tell us your gender (used for Premium matching):
gender_set_male: ✅ Gender set to Male. Use /search to find a stranger!
gender_set_female: ✅ Gender set to Female. Use /search to find a stranger!
abuse_restricted: ⚠️ You've been restricted for a short period due to policy violations.
delivery_failed:

feedback_thanks:

premium_hint: 💡 Tip: 🔥 VIP users get faster matches — use /pay to unlock priority access.
connected_stranger: ✅ Connected! Say hello to your stranger 👋
already_in_chat: 💬 You're already in a chat. Use /next or /stop first.
not_in_chat: You're not in a chat. Use /search to start.
chat_ended: 🛑 Chat ended. Use /search whenever you're ready.
partner_left_next: Your partner has left the chat. Use /search to find a new stranger.
partner_left_stop: Your partner has left. Use /search to find a new stranger.
choose_plan: 💳 Choose a plan: ⭐ Premium — {premium_price} Stars → Gender filter: match only males or females → 👀 Premium unlocks more users in the pool 👑 VIP — {vip_price} Stars → Priority queue: get matched faster → 🔥 VIP users get faster matches — skip the wait Powered by Telegram Stars
vip_info: 👑 VIP Plan Price: {vip_price} Telegram Stars Benefits: • 🔥 Priority queue — always matched before Free and Premium users • ⚡ Skip the wait — average match time under 10 seconds • 👀 Access to a larger pool of active users Valid for {subscription_days} days.
premium_plan_description: Unlock gender filter — choose to match only with male or female strangers. Valid for 30 days.
vip_plan_description: Get priority matching — jump to the front of the queue and get matched faster than everyone else. Valid for 30 days.
partner_disconnected:
